title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity.

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.
  
  
  
  
Our Mumbai office was launched in 2024, marking an exciting new chapter for us. We’re building the team with people who are eager to shape something from the ground up — combining the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a startup with the backing and reach of a global brand.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join Sia’s AI Factory (AIF), embedded directly within a client’s engineering, product, or service team. This role combines hands-on software engineering with client-facing delivery to close platform gaps and deliver production use cases. You will work within the client’s codebase and engineering standards, owning agreed deliverables from understanding requirements through deployment and handover.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work embedded within the client’s team, participating in planning, standups, and delivery activities alongside client and Sia engineers.

* Translate client needs into scoped technical deliverables, clear acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.

* Design, develop, and deploy production-quality Python backend services, APIs, connectors, and integrations.

* Identify and address platform gaps within the agreed scope, aligning architectural changes and dependencies with the relevant owners.

* Develop and integrate RAG pipelines, tool-calling agents, and LLM workflows using approved model gateways and data sources, with appropriate evaluation and safeguards.

* Deliver use cases alongside platform improvements, balancing delivery timelines with maintainability, security, and reliability.

* Apply code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, logging, and monitoring; track quality, latency, and cost for delivered AI components.

* Communicate technical trade-offs, progress, blockers, and risks clearly to client stakeholders, escalating scope changes and dependencies early.

* Document technical decisions and operational procedures, and provide knowledge transfer so the client’s team can maintain and operate the solution.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience: 3–6 years of software development experience, with a strong focus on Python backend development in production.

* Strong Python skills and experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or a comparable framework, including API design and system integrations.

* Ability to understand unfamiliar codebases, troubleshoot issues, and contribute production-quality code.

* Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, a cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and Docker, Git, CI/CD, and automated testing.

* Practical experience with RAG, LLM applications, or tool-calling workflows, including an understanding of retrieval, evaluation, and AI safety considerations.

* Comfort working within an embedded client team, clarifying ambiguous requirements, and taking ownership of agreed deliverables.

* Experience working within governed enterprise environments, including approved libraries and services, data access controls, and security review processes.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

* Good to have: agent orchestration frameworks, vector search tools, enterprise GenAI platforms, Kubernetes, or NoSQL databases.

* Good to have: Spark, Databricks, prior consulting or client-facing delivery, or experience in regulated domains such as financial services, healthcare, or the public sector.

**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to lead cutting-edge AI projects in a global consulting environment.
* Leadership development programs and training sessions at our global centers.
* A dynamic and collaborative team environment with diverse projects.

**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)**

title: Solutions Architect - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production.
  
  
This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
  
  
Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
  
  
This role is highly hands-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long-term architecture for AI-native development.
  
  
The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development**

* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly

**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**

* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments

**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**

* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves

**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**

* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization

**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**

* Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without

**Shape the Future of the Product**

* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

**You may be a fit if**

* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

title: Software Development Manager - Derivatives
description:
We are looking for a Software Development Manager to serve as the overall engineering leader for Derivatives. This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role — responsible for driving the engineering architecture, technical direction, and delivery of derivatives capabilities across the platform. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and derivatives domain expertise, covering trade lifecycle management, valuation/pricing, and downstream processing across FX, Interest Rate, Credit, Equity, and Commodity derivatives. You will architect and build systems that are correct, auditable, and performant at scale, working closely with quants, traders, operations, and risk teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build scalable, resilient systems for derivatives trade capture, lifecycle event processing (resets, fixings, exercises, novations, terminations, amendments), and downstream settlement/confirmation workflows.
* Own architecture decisions for pricing and valuation services, including integration with pricing libraries/models and market data feeds for FX, IR, Credit, Equity, and Commodity derivatives.
* Build and maintain data models and event-driven pipelines that support accurate position keeping, P&L, and risk reporting across the trade lifecycle.
* Partner with quant and risk teams to translate valuation and pricing logic into robust, testable, production-grade code.
* Drive engineering best practices: system design reviews, code quality, test automation, observability, and performance tuning for high-throughput, low-latency workflows.
* Collaborate with operations and business stakeholders to understand STP requirements, exception handling, and reconciliation needs across the trade lifecycle.
* Mentor engineers, contribute to technical roadmap decisions, and raise the bar on engineering rigor across the team.
* Contribute to hedge accounting workflows where applicable, including effectiveness testing support.

**Qualifications**
**Technical**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of designing and building complex, distributed, data-intensive systems.
* Deep proficiency in at least one modern backend language (Java, Python, or similar) and strong system design fundamentals (scalability, data modeling, API design, event-driven architecture).
* Experience with relational and/or time-series databases, messaging systems (Kafka or similar), and building services that operate under strict accuracy and auditability requirements.
* Comfort working across the full stack of a trading platform: trade capture, lifecycle processing, valuation integration, and reporting/reconciliation.

**Domain**

* Solid understanding of derivatives lifecycle management across FX, Interest Rate, Credit, Equity, and Commodity products — including trade events such as fixings, resets, exercises, novations, and terminations.
* Working knowledge of valuation and pricing concepts for these asset classes (e.g., discounting curves, forward/NPV calculations, sensitivities) — you don't need to build pricing models yourself, but you must understand how they plug into the systems you build.
* Familiarity with middle/back office processes: confirmations, settlements, reconciliation, and regulatory/reporting considerations for derivatives.

**Nice to Have**

* Understanding of hedge accounting concepts (e.g., fair value/cash flow hedges) and hedge effectiveness testing methodologies.
* Experience with regulatory reporting frameworks for derivatives (e.g., Dodd-Frank, EMIR, MiFID II).
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure and modern DevOps practices in a regulated financial environment.

* Architect scalable cloud-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
* Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.

* Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.

* Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.

* Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk-sensitive environments.

* Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
* Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.

**Business Development & GTM Initiatives**

* Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
* Develop industry-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
* Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.

* Oversee end-to-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
* Manage cross-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
* Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.

**Practice Development & Team Leadership**

* Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
* Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
* Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.

**Education:**
B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).
  
  
**Core Technical Expertise (Hands-on Implementation Required):**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation & Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.

title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote India)
description:
**Help build the open future of digital intelligence**
At InnoCraft (trading as Matomo), we believe everyone has the right to data sovereignty, privacy and trusted analytics insights.
  
  
Born from open source and backed by a global community, Matomo helps organisations understand their users and digital performance without surrendering ownership, privacy or control of their data.
  
  
Today, Matomo is used on more than one million websites across 190 countries, supporting leading brands, national governments, universities and organisations in regulated industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Product Engineer to help organisations make sense of their digital performance as AI changes how people discover and interact with them. You’ll help decide which problems matter most, shape solutions and deliver software that gives customers clearer insights while protecting their privacy and ownership of their data. Working closely with Product and your engineering team, you’ll have the trust and responsibility to take ideas through to measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
This is an opportunity to take real ownership, solve challenging product and platform problems, and see your work make a difference in a widely used open-source product.
  
  
**Why this role matters**
Customers need confidence in their data, a clear understanding of their users and tools that help them act on what they learn. As digital behaviour changes, Matomo needs to meet those needs while remaining accessible to smaller organisations and capable enough for demanding enterprise use.
  
  
Our Product Engineering teams focus on five domains:
**Measurement Integrity, Human Analytics, AI Analytics & Digital Presence, Growth & Web, and Enterprise Platform**
. You’ll work within one of these domains, collaborating across teams where customer problems and technical decisions overlap.
  
  
You’ll build new capabilities and improve a mature, widely used product. That means understanding existing systems, choosing practical solutions and evolving Matomo with care for the customers, open-source users, integrations and plugins that depend on it.]
  
  
Your work will directly influence:
  
  

* The accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers use to make decisions.
* How clearly customers understand human behaviour and their digital presence as AI changes how people discover and interact with them.
* How easily customers get started, find value and grow their use of Matomo.
* How effectively enterprise customers manage access, governance and integrations at scale.

We make extensive use of approved AI tools throughout our engineering workflow, from exploring ideas and prototyping to building, reviewing and testing software. We expect you to use them to move faster and improve quality, while applying your own judgement and taking responsibility for the decisions you make and the software you ship.
  
  
**What you’ll own**

* Understand the problem. Work with Product, colleagues and customers to uncover needs, question assumptions and agree what a useful outcome looks like.
* Shape the solution. Explore options, test ideas through prototypes and make clear trade-offs about scope, complexity and what to deliver first.
* Build across the stack. Own the technical design and implementation, choosing practical solutions that fit the product and its existing systems.
* Build quality in from the start. Work with QA and Design as needed, considering privacy, security, accessibility, performance and compatibility throughout delivery.
* Deliver and learn. Ship in small increments, take responsibility for how your changes work in production, and use customer feedback and evidence to measure results and improve them.
* Use AI effectively throughout delivery. Give tools the context they need, challenge their suggestions and verify the results. Keep privacy, security and maintainability central to the work you ship.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years experience delivering full-stack software, with the technical depth to investigate difficult problems and make sound design decisions.
* Product judgement and a drive to solve real customer problems. You can explain why a change is worth building and care whether people use and benefit from it.
* Confidence taking ownership of outcomes, clarifying problems and shaping solutions without needing every requirement spelled out in a ticket.
* Confidence working in mature systems, understanding existing behaviour and improving it without unnecessary rewrites.
* The ability to balance delivery speed with quality, privacy, security and backwards compatibility.
* Strong experience using AI throughout development: refining requirements, preparing clear context for prompts, building and testing solutions, and checking the results. You keep reusable AI skills and instructions up to date, follow developments in models and tools, and experiment with new ways to improve delivery and quality.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly in a global, asynchronous environment
* A strong record of taking ownership, exercising sound judgement and delivering measurable outcomes

**Helpful experience**

* You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback.
* Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue.js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems.
* Experience in product management, UI/UX design or building your own product or business.
* Contributing to or maintaining open-source projects, or building plugins, APIs and integrations used across different environments.
* Analytics, data-intensive systems or enterprise software.

You may not match every item, but you should bring strong capability in the core requirements and a clear record of creating meaningful impact.
  
  
**Why Matomo?**
Matomo is for people who want their work to matter.
  
  
You will help build technology that protects data privacy, strengthens digital sovereignty and gives organisations a genuine alternative to surveillance-based platforms.
  
  
We are intentionally lean, globally distributed and backed by a worldwide open-source community. Important work is not buried under layers. You will have access to meaningful problems, the context behind decisions and the opportunity to influence what Matomo becomes next.
  
  
We value people who take ownership, exercise strong judgement and turn complex problems into clear, valuable outcomes. People who raise standards, challenge assumptions and care about the complete result, not only their part of it.
  
  
High performance at Matomo means choosing the work that matters most, moving it forward with urgency and leaving customers, colleagues and Matomo stronger because of your contribution.
  
  
You will have freedom over where and, within the needs of your role, when you work. In return, we expect clear communication, dependable follow-through and accountability for outcomes.
  
  
We also protect focused work through:
  
  

* No-meeting Fridays
* No more than two days each week with late meetings
* No meetings after 10pm in any time zone

This is a place for people who want meaningful responsibility, visible impact and the opportunity to help build something globally significant.
  
  
**Benefits**

* 100% remote working within your country of employment
* Flexible working hours, within the collaboration and coverage requirements of the role
* 25 days of paid annual leave
* Home-office equipment allowance
* Health insurance support, where applicable
* Mental-health and wellbeing support
* Paid volunteering day
* Pet bereavement leave

Benefits vary depending on the country of employment.
  
  
**Hiring Process**
Application → Screening → Online aptitude test → People & Culture interview → Hiring Manager/Behaviour interview→ Live Coding test (Final round)
  
  
**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
Matomo values what makes you unique. We’re an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products.
  
  
**Fight for data privacy. Build the open future of digital intelligence. Create meaningful impact from anywhere.**
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* HTML5, CSS3 — for designing accessible, responsive interfaces
* RESTful APIs and client-server architecture — experience in designing and consuming APIs for seamless integration
* SQL Server and Entity Framework Core — solid knowledge of database modeling, query optimization, and ORM techniques
* Git and version control workflows — proficiency in source code management, branching, and collaboration

* Collaborate with stakeholders, product owners, and team members to define features and deliver requirements

* Stay updated on Angular, .NET, cloud technologies, and industry trends to continuously improve solutions

* Design and implement robust state & memory management for autonomous agents—handle checkpointing, persistent context storage, efficient serialization/retrieval, and scalable memory‑access patterns to support long‑running, multi‑turn interactions while maintaining consistency and compliance.
* Develop AI‑powered CRM capabilities such as customer profiling, lead qualification, meeting preparation, interaction summarization, follow‑up generation and next‑best‑action recommendation. Build natural‑language interfaces that let users query customer information, generate insights and trigger workflows conversationally. Enable agents to retrieve context, update CRM records and execute authorized actions while integrating LLM reasoning with business‑rule engines and existing CRM processes
* Engineer scalable backend services and APIs (Python, FastAPI, async) that expose agent functionality, integrate with CRM systems, databases, email/calendar services, document repositories and external APIs. Implement reliable execution patterns – background jobs, message queues, retries, timeouts, idempotency and fault tolerance – and construct event‑driven architectures with Kafka or RabbitMQ.

Design and operate AI‑infrastructure and LLMOps pipelines: containerize services (Docker), orchestrate on‑prem or cloud‑native Kubernetes clusters (Helm, Argo CD GitOps), manage CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and implement observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) together with model‑lifecycle tooling (MLflow, experiment tracking, model registry). Optimize latency, throughput, concurrency, resource utilization and inference cost; enforce access controls, tenant isolation, secrets management and audit trails.
  
  

* Provide technical leadership across product, engineering and compliance teams: own end‑to‑end architecture, prototype, productionise and maintain AI solutions; develop reusable frameworks and standards for agentic AI; conduct code and architecture reviews; mentor junior engineers; and continuously evaluate emerging agentic‑AI frameworks, models and deployment technologies for product relevance.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Proficiency in tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio)
* Familiarity with software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
* Familiarity with Oracle databases, Understanding schema, SQL
* Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
* Quick to learn and adapt
* Good Team player
* Someone who could have long-term commitment with the team and organization

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Agentic AI & Multi‑Agent Systems – Mastery of LangGraph / LangChain, tool‑calling, function‑calling, planning, task decomposition, state management, checkpointing, retries, human‑in‑the‑loop approval and performance metrics (completion rate, accuracy, latency, cost).
* LLM & RAG Engineering – End‑to‑end RAG pipeline design, context‑engineering, prompt optimization, grounding, hallucination mitigation, token‑window management, caching strategies and multi‑provider model routing.
* AI‑Powered CRM Capability Design – Ability to translate CRM domain expertise into intelligent features (profiling, scoring, summarization, recommendation) and embed LLM‑driven reasoning with rule‑engine and workflow automation.
* Backend & Integration Engineering – Delivery of high‑availability micro‑services (FastAPI/Node.js), event‑driven pipelines (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Avro/Schema Registry), secure API‑gateway configuration (Kong) and robust integration adapters that enforce permission models and idempotent behavior.
* Cloud‑Native & DevOps Practices – Deep experience with Docker, Kubernetes (multi‑namespace, Helm, Argo CD), CI/CD automation, Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform, Pulumi) and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki).
* Data & Retrieval Engineering – Proficiency with SQL/relational databases, vector‑search technologies, document processing, feature‑store patterns (Feast, Redis), data‑quality governance, schema evolution and caching.
* Machine‑Learning Foundations – Practical knowledge of scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, model training/evaluation, hyper‑parameter tuning and lifecycle management with MLflow.
* Security, Governance & Compliance – Implementation of permission‑aware tool execution, audit logging, model governance and adherence to AML, GDPR and internal risk‑management policies.
* Performance Measurement & Optimization – Definition and monitoring of agent/LLM metrics (accuracy, latency, cost), systematic A/B testing and optimization techniques (semantic caching, prompt caching, context compression).

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with vLLM, LoRA/QLoRA fine‑tuning, quantization and GPU‑based model serving behind firewalls.
* Hands‑on work with LLM evaluation and tracing platforms such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Phoenix, OpenTelemetry or comparable tools.
* Advanced agentic‑AI patterns: durable execution, Model‑Context Protocol (MCP), persistent agent memory and sophisticated human‑in‑the‑loop workflows.
* Proficiency with common ML libraries (scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) for rapid prototyping and model development.
* Knowledge‑graph expertise (Neo4j, Memgraph, TigerGraph, Amazon Neptune, JanusGraph) for large‑scale network analytics and entity resolution.
* Experience with large‑scale streaming and batch processing frameworks (Kafka, Spark, Flink, Delta Lake) and data‑pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow).
* Familiarity with multi‑tenant SaaS architecture, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, SSO and enterprise identity‑management solutions.
* Background in recommendation, ranking, lead‑scoring, customer segmentation, forecasting or churn‑prediction models for CRM intelligence.
* Infrastructure‑automation expertise (Terraform, Pulumi, GitOps, Helm, Argo CD) and sandbox quota management for GPU nodes.

**Specific Qualifications:**
NA
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Core Programming & Software Engineering – Python, FastAPI/Flask, asynchronous development, REST/GraphQL APIs, SQL/relational databases, Git version control, automated testing, CI/CD best practices.
* Agentic AI & LLM Engineering – LangGraph/LangChain, tool/function calling, state & memory management, planning, task decomposition, multi‑agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, vector‑DB integration, prompt engineering, cost & rate‑limit controls, model routing.
* Backend & Integration Engineering – High‑availability micro‑services (FastAPI/Node.js), event‑driven pipelines (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Avro/Schema Registry), API‑gateway configuration (Kong), rule‑engine integration (Drools or custom), secure credential handling, idempotent design.
* Cloud‑Native & DevOps – Docker, Kubernetes (multi‑namespace, Helm, Argo CD GitOps), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI), IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki), secrets management, tenant isolation.
* Data & Retrieval Engineering – Structured and semi‑structured data handling, document ingestion & processing, embedding generation, vector‑search (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate), feature‑store patterns (Feast, Redis), data lineage, quality and governance.
* Machine‑Learning Foundations – Scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, model training, evaluation, hyper‑parameter optimization, MLflow experiment tracking, model registry and artifact versioning.
* Collaboration & Problem‑Solving – Cross‑functional communication, stakeholder alignment, comprehensive documentation, mentorship, systematic troubleshooting and adaptability to regulated environments.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Collaboration & Communication – Proven ability to work in globally distributed, cross‑functional teams; translate complex AI concepts into actionable specifications; produce clear technical documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger, design specs); mentor junior engineers.

* Professional Background – bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, AI or related discipline (or equivalent experience); ≥ 7 years of demonstrable experience delivering production‑grade software and AI systems; documented ownership of end‑to‑end AI product features.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

Mumbai

title: Consulting Architect - Search
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
We are seeking an exceptional and highly experienced
**Consulting Architect**
to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on-site client engagement.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**
As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
  
  
Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
  
  
Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
  
  
**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Search.
* Experience in solving complex technical search problems in terms of relevancy, scaling, performance fine-tuning, building a platform to handle high query throughputs and indexing throughput, benchmarking clusters to achieve optimal performance.
* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)
* Work Style: Comfortable working effectively in a highly distributed and remote team, spanning multiple global time zones.
* BS or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

**Bonus Points:**

* Familiarity/Experience in implementing similar products in Search Domain (Solr, Algolia, Open Search)
* Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications (e.g., Elastic Certified Analyst, Specializations) and/or specialization in machine learning, data analytics.
* Experience working closely with a pre-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).
* Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

title: NX Customization Engineer
description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
  
  
**About The Role**
Job Summary
  
  
The Product Development Engineer is responsible for improving or developing new products, components, equipment, systems, technologies, or processes. This role ensures that research and design methodologies meet scientific and engineering standards and supports the organization in achieving technical, functional, and cost targets.
  
  
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
  
  
Additional information
  
  
**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

That is why Third Bridge is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: TPRM Java - Technical Lead
description:
Java Full Stack Developer with Backend Focus
  
  
**Role**
Java Full Stack Developer — Backend Focus
  
  
**Grade**
Assistant Vice President
  
  
**Location**
Mumbai
  
  
**Reports To**
TBC
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
Position Purpose
  
  
Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable Java-based backend services and middle business layer components within enterprise full-stack applications. Own backend architecture decisions, API design, data access patterns, and integration with upstream and downstream systems. Work competently across the existing frontend layer using Angular/TypeScript/React
**.**
Bring the depth of an experienced backend engineer with the breadth to contribute across the full stack. Leverage AI-assisted development tools as a standard part of day-to-day engineering practice.
  
  
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and Develop scalable full-stack solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular).
* Design and optimize high-performance APIs with security, caching, and fault tolerance.
* Design and Develop robust backend services with efficient database interactions.
* Build responsive UI with seamless backend integration.
* Automate CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable software delivery.
* Lead cloud-native deployments with containerization, auto-scaling, and cost optimization.
* Enforce Quality-first engineering: Unit, integration, and ensure high code quality with SonarQube.
* Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and drive technical excellence across the team.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into robust, compliant technical solutions.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture decisions, particularly around API design, data layer, and system integration
* Participate in code reviews and enforce clean code and quality gate standards
* Support knowledge transfer and capability building within the India Solutions team
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, QA, infrastructure) on integration and delivery
* Improving DevSecOps maturity and SDLC practices within the team

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Experience Level: 8+ years**

* 7+ years with Java backend development at enterprise scale
* 5+ years with Spring Boot/Spring MVC in production environments
* Demonstrated good experience across the listed Technical skills.
* Familiarity with frontend integration using Angular/TypeScript/React
* Experience with legacy system refactoring to target architecture
* Active use of AI coding assistants in daily workflow

**Domain Experience**

* Banking, financial services, or similarly regulated enterprise environments preferred
* Experience in GCC or offshore delivery models advantageous
* Exposure to high-volume, high-availability backend systems

Technical Skills
  
  
**Required**
**Skill Group**
**Details**
**Core Java & JDK 21+**

* Modern language features – records, sealed classes, pattern‑matching, text blocks, and functional APIs (streams, Optional).
* Concurrency & Parallelism – virtual threads (Project Loom), Completable Future, Executor Service, Fork/Join, and basic lock/atomic primitives.
* JVM & GC tuning – G1/ZGC behaviour, heap‑dump analysis, JFR profiling, and module‑system (JPMS) usage.
* Logging / Instrumentation / Error Handling
* Build & Unit‑test foundation – Maven/Gradle multi‑module builds, JUnit 5 + AssertJ, static code checks (SpotBugs), and basic GraalVM native‑image awareness.

**Spring Ecosystem**

* Spring Boot 3.x – create micro‑service skeletons, auto‑configuration, actuator health‑checks, and simple security (JWT/OAuth2).,
* Spring Data (JPA/R2DBC) – entity mapping, query‑hint optimisation, reactive repositories, and transaction demarcation.
* Spring Cloud basics – service discovery (Eureka), API‑gateway pattern, externalized config (Config Server), and circuit‑breaker (Resilience4j).
* Either Spring Batch OR Spring MVC OR Spring Integration
* Spring Security– CSRF protection, OAuth2 resource‑server setup, basic role‑based access control, and token validation, zero trust, MTLS.

**Database & Data Access Engineering**

* SQL & query optimisation – complex CTEs, window functions, indexing strategies, and execution‑plan analysis (PostgreSQL/Oracle/MySQL).
* Database optimisation - (indexing, query plans). Understanding of partitioning
* ORM performance – JPA/Hibernate mapping, N+1 detection, second‑level cache, batch inserts/updates, and @QueryHints.
* NoSQL & caching – when to use MongoDB, GraphDB, Redis (session/Cache‑aside), basic data‑modeling, and TTL/eviction policies.
* Migrations & transactions – Flyway/Liquibase versioning, multi‑DB transaction handling (JTA), and isolation‑level choices.

**Design & Architecture**

* Clean / Hexagonal architecture – ports‑and‑adapters, dependency‑inversion, and keeping frameworks at the outer ring.
* Domain‑Driven Design basics – bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and idempotent processing.
* API‑first & contract – OpenAPI/Swagger spec authoring, versioning strategy, and consumer‑driven contract testing (Pact).
* Event‑driven patterns – Kafka or RabbitMQ producers/consumers, out‑box pattern, and basic saga (choreography) implementation.
* Security: Public Keys / Hash Concepts. Design around Access Control, Role Based security.
* Microservices design Pattern ex: SAGA Design pattern

Concepts like -Circuit breaker, load balancer, Reverse Proxy
  
  

* Integration Patterns, Enterprise Patterns, Application scalability (stateful & stateless), Microservices Patterns, Distributed Transactions
* Caching Strategies (Redis, CDN)

**DevOps**

* Containerisation & K8s – Docker multi‑stage builds, Helm chart basics, pod liveness/readiness probes.
* CI/CD pipeline – Jenkins/Argo CD job that runs unit, integration, and static‑analysis steps; artefact publishing. Pipeline-as-code (Jenkinsfile/YAML)
* Observability starter – expose Prometheus metrics, configure a basic Grafana dashboard, and ship structured logs to ELK.
* Runtime security, secret‑management (CyberArk / Hashicorp / equivalent)
* Canary/blue‑green release patterns

**Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Test‑pyramid implementation – unit (JUnit 5/Mockito), integration (Testcontainers), contract (Pact).
* Performance & load testing – JMeter script creation, baseline latency/SLO definition, simple analysis of results.
* Static analysis & coverage – SonarQube quality gate, JaCoCo coverage threshold, SpotBugs rule set.

**Frontend**
Proficient working within existing Angular/TypeScript/NodeJS/NPM frameworks.
  
  
**AI Tools**
Daily use of AI DevAssistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate implementation across all skill areas
  
  
Understanding of MCP and Agentic concepts and able to develop and design.
  
  
Experience with Prompt Engineering, codebase context and constraints of AI assistants
  
  
**Behavioral Skills**

* Sets technical direction for multiple squads and aligns it with business objectives
* Cross-functional collaboration across frontend, QA, DecvSecOps and infrastructure teams
* Balances speed, quality, and regulatory constraints in a fast-moving environment and is results oriented
* Ensures that security, data‑privacy, and regulatory requirements are baked in.
* Structured communication of technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders
* Adaptability to legacy and greenfield environments delivering modern, cloud‑native solutions.
* Leverages generative AI to boost productivity and foster a culture of experimentation

**Education Level:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

*be your best*

* Skilled in extracting, transforming, modeling, and analyzing complex datasets using Python, SQL Server, and AI technologies, enabling continuous process improvement and advanced analytics.

**Education / Qualifications**

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

title: Platform Customer Engineer, Manufacturing and Conglomerates
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.
* Experience translating customer objectives into integrated cloud solutions across multiple domains.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data management, data analytics, Cloud AI, networking, migrations, security.
* Experience managing the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, or penetration testing).

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration testing within existing ones as a technical generalist. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and direct technical engagement.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting specific sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture to show the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots, and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration, or implementation phases.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Operating System Engineer
description:
Required Background and Prior Experience

We are seeking a hands-on engineer who has previously built and supported production healthcare software comparable to VerityOS.

1. Relevant healthcare product experience — mandatory

The candidate must have personally developed substantial components of a live U.S. healthcare product involving one or more of the following:

\* Practice management.

\* Medical billing and revenue cycle management.

\* EHR-connected patient engagement and operational workflows.

The product must have been used by real healthcare organizations. Coursework, prototypes, chatbot demonstrations, and internal proof-of-concept projects alone do not qualify.

2. Billing and RCM engineering experience — mandatory

The candidate must have hands-on experience implementing healthcare billing workflows, including:

\* Claim creation/submission and acknowledgment or rejection handling.

\* Electronic remittance or EOB processing and payment posting.

\* Denial management and accounts-receivable workflows.

\* Patient balances, adjustments, and reconciliation.

They must understand the distinction between charges, claims, payments, adjustments, and patient responsibility, and explain how their system prevented duplicate transactions and preserved financial history.

They do not need to have built every billing component independently, but must clearly identify the components they personally implemented.

3. EHR or healthcare-system integration experience — mandatory

The candidate must have delivered at least one production integration with an EHR, practice-management system, or healthcare clearinghouse.

Relevant experience includes approved APIs, FHIR, HL7, healthcare transaction interfaces, or secure data exchanges.

They must demonstrate experience with patient matching, synchronization, conflicting updates, failed transactions, and reconciliation. General API experience alone is insufficient.

4. Secure application architecture — mandatory

The candidate must have implemented:

\* Role-based permissions and server-side access controls.

\* Audit trails and sensitive-data protection.

\* Separation of customer organizations’ data.

\* Secure credential management.

\* Backup, recovery, monitoring, and incident handling.

Experience with a platform serving multiple independent practices or customer organizations is strongly preferred.

5. Hands-on full-stack development — mandatory

The candidate must be able to personally design databases, develop backend services and user interfaces, write meaningful tests, deploy applications, and troubleshoot production issues.

This is a building role, not solely a project-management, consulting, or architecture role.

6. Production ownership — mandatory

The candidate must have supported a product after launch, including resolving incidents, releasing upgrades, managing database changes, and maintaining integrations.

They should be able to describe a significant production failure, its impact, how it was resolved, and what was changed to prevent recurrence.

7. Workflow automation experience — mandatory

The candidate must have built workflows involving task assignment, statuses, deadlines, escalation, document handling, and external-system events.

They must understand how to handle retries, duplicate events, incomplete information, and human review.

8. AI and communications experience — strongly preferred

Preference will be given to candidates who have deployed:

\* AI document extraction with validation.

\* Tool-using AI agents with defined permissions and human handoff.

\* Voice agents or telephony integrations.

\* Two-way SMS, e-fax, or secure patient messaging.

Candidates must distinguish production deployments from experimental projects.

9. Patient-facing and specialty experience — preferred

Relevant additional experience includes patient portals, caregiver access, scheduling, authorization workflows, procedure-resource scheduling, infusions, or other specialty-practice operations.

Neurology experience is valuable but not mandatory.

Evidence required with the application

Please provide two relevant project examples. For each, describe:

\* The product and type of healthcare organization it served.

\* Whether it reached production and how long you supported it.

\* Your exact role and the components you personally built.

\* EHRs, clearinghouses, or communications systems integrated.

\* The scale of deployment, where disclosure is permitted.

\* A difficult technical problem and how you resolved it.

\* A professional reference who can verify your contribution.

Confidential client names may be withheld initially. Use anonymized descriptions and synthetic data; do not disclose patient information or proprietary code.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
  
  
You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter-personal skills to build the required relationships.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**

* Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
* Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
* Code Python is a plus.
* Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API-calls and MCP- servers is key.
* Build end-to-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
* Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
* Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
* Implement Fiori-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
* Integrate with SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
* Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
* Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in-app/extensibility, key-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean-core approach where applicable).
* Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
* Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root-cause analysis

**Qualification And Experience Required -**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
* Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
* SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
* SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
* Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
* Proven delivery experience with:
* RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
* CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
* OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
* Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
* Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
* BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
* Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.

Exol is seeking a Go-to-Market Engineer — operating as our Senior, Go-to-Market Operations Analyst — who will own and re-architect the systems that power our outbound engine. This person comes in to completely overhaul Clay, take ownership of our sales engagement platform (the parallel dialer and sequencing tool our SDRs run on), and architect the tooling behind our inbound, outbound, and future GTM motions. This is a builder's role: you're not maintaining what exists, you're rebuilding it for scale.

**What we do**

Exol is pioneering warehousing-as-a-service, offering outsourced warehousing operations, and specializing in automated warehousing solutions. Our focus is on the efficient movement of goods in cases and pallets across all sectors, such as wholesale, retail, and general merchandising.

Exol is an independently managed joint venture between Symbotic and Softbank.

**What you'll do**

* Take ownership of Clay and re-architect it from the ground up — enrichment waterfalls, ICP scoring models, credit governance, list building, and clean data flow into the CRM
* Own our sales engagement platform end-to-end — the parallel dialer and sequencing engine for the SDR team: sequence architecture, dialer configuration, deliverability, sender rotation, A/B testing, and performance monitoring
* Architect the tooling and automation behind our inbound, outbound, and future GTM motions as a single, scalable system

* Partner with SDR leadership and Revenue Operations on process, cadence, and enablement alignment
* Create documentation, runbooks, and changelogs for every change — nothing goes live without documentation

**What you'll need**

* 3+ years in a GTM Engineering, Revenue Systems Engineering, or Sales Operations Engineering role at a B2B company
* Deep, hands-on Clay expertise (required) — waterfall enrichment, ICP list building, credit management, and enrichment pipeline architecture, with the ability to overhaul and re-architect from scratch
* Hands-on experience owning a sales engagement platform — parallel dialer and sequencing tooling (e.g., Orum/Nooks-style dialers, Outreach/Salesloft/Apollo sequencing)
* Strong CRM platform expertise (HubSpot preferred): workflows, custom objects, lead scoring, lifecycle management, routing, and API integrations
* Experience supporting an outbound SDR team (3–10+ reps) and owning the tooling and automation stack that team ran on
* Integration and scripting comfort — JavaScript or Python, and orchestration platforms (Make.com, Zapier, n8n, or direct API)
* Proven ability to build GTM infrastructure from scratch at a scaling company, not just maintain existing systems
* Documentation-first mindset
* Coding experience (optional, but preferred)

description:

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Lead Architect – Full-Stack, Cloud, Data & AI Engineering**
*Technical leadership of the end-to-end build, with accountability for establishing the team's deployment capability and mentoring Forward Deployed Engineers to independence*
**Role Overview**
The Lead Architect sets and owns the technical direction for enterprise agentic AI solutions across application, cloud, data and AI layers — and delivers it through the team rather than personally. The primary mandate is to raise engineering capability: establish standards and reusable deployment assets, guide design and review work, and mentor Forward Deployed Engineers until they can build, deploy and operate solutions in client environments without escalation. Hands-on work is expected selectively — to stay technically credible and unblock the team — not as sustained feature delivery.

**Full-stack engineering**
