title: AI Platform Tech Lead
description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

*Lead how Sovos designs, operates, and scales AI across the business*
 Sovos is transforming how the world's businesses navigate an increasingly complex tax and regulatory landscape, while simultaneously reinventing how we build software. Within the Office of the CTO, the Sovos Platform organization is growing our AI Platform team \- responsible for LLMOps foundation, tooling, and architectural patterns that let every engineering team at Sovos build and ship with AI responsibly and effectively.
   

  

 We're looking for an AI Tech Lead to guide that foundation from the inside. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering, architecture, and enablement \- leading the technical decisions that shape our LLMOps practice, guiding the engineers who build it, and acting as the connective tissue between the AI Platform team and every other team at Sovos learning to build with these tools. This is a highly visible role with a direct line to how AI gets used across the company.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
***Guiding LLMOps Strategy and Team Execution***
* You'll provide the technical leadership that keeps our LLMOps practice coherent as it scales \- guiding the AI Platform team's day\-to\-day decisions and making sure the practice holds together as new models, tools, and use cases arrive.
* Guide and support the AI Platform team on LLMOps decisions: model selection, evaluation strategy, prompt and context management, observability, and cost governance
* Set technical direction for how Sovos deploys, monitors, and continuously improves LLM\-based and agentic systems in production
* Establish standards and guardrails for prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI usage across teams
* Own the health of our LLMOps tooling and observability stack, and make the build\-vs\-buy calls as the landscape evolves


***Shaping Design and Architecture Decisions***
* You'll bring architectural rigor to how AI capabilities get built into the Sovos Platform, ensuring new AI features are designed to scale and integrate cleanly with Core Platform, Sovos Identity, and our broader compliance infrastructure.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to design AI\-enabled features and agentic services, from prototype through production
* Review and advise on technical designs across teams building on the AI Platform, flagging risk and identifying reuse opportunities early
* Help define the architectural patterns and reference implementations (skills, MCP tools, agent frameworks) other teams build from
* Balance rapid experimentation with the long\-term architectural integrity of the platform


***Partnering with Teams Across Sovos***
* Platform capabilities only create value once teams can actually use them. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for teams learning to adopt our LLMOps and AI toolsets, translating platform capability into practical, everyday workflows.
* Act as a trusted advisor to product and engineering teams adopting AI coding assistants, agentic frameworks, and platform APIs
* Run workshops, office hours, and hands\-on sessions that teach teams how to use platform\-level LLM Ops and AI tooling effectively
* Translate platform capabilities into clear guidance, playbooks, and Skills that make the right way the easy way
* Communicate AI Platform direction and adoption progress to engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and the broader organization


***Leading and Growing the Team***
* You'll provide day\-to\-day guidance and technical leadership to the engineers building the AI Platform, raising the bar on quality while keeping the team moving fast.
* Guide and mentor AI Platform engineers, providing technical direction, code and design review, and career development
* Foster a culture of rapid experimentation, rigorous evaluation, and continuous learning
* Remove blockers so the team can ship reliable AI capabilities quickly
* Partner with the Chief Architect on team structure, hiring, and roadmap prioritization


**What We Need From You**
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on time building and operating LLM\-based or agentic AI systems in production
* Deep familiarity with LLMOps practice: evaluation frameworks, observability and monitoring, prompt engineering, cost and performance optimization
* Experience guiding or leading engineers, whether as a formal manager, tech lead, or through mentorship and technical authority
* Strong architectural instincts \- comfortable making and defending design decisions that other teams will build on
* Hands\-on experience with modern AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar)
* Technical depth across full\-stack development; familiarity with JavaScript/React and Java or .NET service\-oriented systems is a strong plus
* Excellent communication skills \- able to explain AI platform concepts clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders
* A track record of enabling other teams: through documentation, shared tooling, workshops, or hands\-on pairing


**What Sets You Apart**
* Experience standing up or scaling an LLMOps practice from the ground up
* A genuine enthusiasm for teaching \- you'd rather show ten teams how to fish than build it for them once
* Comfort operating at the boundary of ambiguity, translating a fast\-moving AI landscape into concrete, adoptable guidance
* Experience balancing platform architecture rigor with the speed a hands\-on tech lead role demands


**What Sovos Offers You**
* Flexibility: 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with remote options for the rest.
* International exposure with a global organization.
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting\-Free Days.
* Mentoring programs and career development opportunities.
* Globally recognized training and development programs.
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage.
* A collaborative environment with modern tools and technologies.


**Our Recruitment Process**
* CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) \& EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
* Automated Video Interview
* Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or team
* Final Interview


**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance, and trust solutions, enabling businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with confidence. With more than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – Sovos processes over three billion transactions annually across 19,000 tax jurisdictions.
   

  

 Founded in 1979, Sovos operates across the Americas and Europe, backed by Hg and TA Associates. Learn more at sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
The role
 



 You will work across mobile, web, backend and cloud infrastructure. This is not a narrow ticket\-execution role: you will understand the user problem, shape requirements, make sound architectural decisions and ship complete features into production in close collaboration with the founder, product, design, AI/video and business teams.
 



 What you will own
 



 Product engineering
 


* Translate product ideas and business requirements into clear technical plans, milestones and production\-ready features.
* Own features end to end: discovery, technical design, implementation, testing, release, monitoring and iteration.
* Balance speed with maintainability, security, scalability and a high\-quality user experience.
* Contribute product judgment—not only code—by identifying edge cases, simplifying flows and recommending better solutions.



  





**FULL STACK DEVELOPER** 




  





**Mobile and web experiences** 



* Build and maintain the consumer mobile application in Flutter, including camera access, video capture and upload, challenge participation, profiles, rewards, notifications and leaderboards.
* Develop responsive web applications and dashboards using React/Next.js for enterprise users, administrators, creators and brand partners.
* Turn designs into polished, intuitive interfaces with strong attention to layout, motion, responsiveness, accessibility and consistency.
* Improve application performance across device types, browsers, network conditions and large media files.



  





**Backend, data and platform architecture** 



* Design and develop secure, well\-structured services and APIs using Node.js/TypeScript; experience with NestJS is preferred.
* Build data models and high\-performance workflows using PostgreSQL, an ORM such as Prisma, Redis and background job queues.
* Implement authentication, role\-based access, permissions, auditability, webhooks and third\-party integrations.
* Support real\-time and high\-engagement features such as scoring updates, leaderboards, notifications, moderation and campaign analytics.
* Design for multi\-tenant enterprise use, data isolation, reliability and increasing volumes of users, campaigns and video assets.



  





**AI and video workflows** 



* Integrate AI services for video scoring and analysis, avatar generation, voice, language, personalisation and content generation.
* Build resilient video ingestion, validation, storage, transcoding, rendering and delivery workflows using object storage, FFmpeg or related media services.
* Create asynchronous processing pipelines with queues, retries, progress states, fallbacks and cost\-aware API usage.
* Help improve trust and safety through moderation, fraud detection, duplicate or manipulated\-content checks and clear human\-review paths.



  










**Engineering quality and operations** 



* Set up and improve automated testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, error tracking, logging and production alerts.
* Deploy and operate services on a major cloud platform using containers and well\-managed environments.
* Diagnose production issues quickly and improve performance, resilience, security and developer efficiency over time.
* Maintain clear technical documentation and communicate progress, trade\-offs and risks to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



  





 What we are looking for:
 



  




* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience building and shipping full\-stack products.
* **Strong Flutter and Dart capability** 
 for production mobile applications.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React or Next.js, Node.js and modern API development.
* Solid experience with PostgreSQL, data modelling, caching, queues and performance optimisation.
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs, SDKs, cloud storage and external services reliably.
* Comfort with Docker, Git, CI/CD and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
* A strong grasp of application security, authentication, permissions, privacy and responsible handling of user and enterprise data.
* **Product\-management ability:** 
 you can break down ambiguous requirements, prioritise, estimate and drive work to completion.
* **Excellent communication skills:** 
 you can explain decisions clearly, surface risks early and collaborate constructively.
* **A strong aesthetic sense** 
 and genuine care for interaction quality, visual polish and the details users notice.
* High ownership, curiosity and comfort working in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can evolve quickly.



  





 Good to have:
 



  




* Experience with media\-heavy applications, video processing, streaming, transcoding or rendering pipelines.
* Experience with AI/ML APIs, multimodal models, recommendation or scoring systems, or human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation.
* Experience building gamification, social, creator, rewards, leaderboard or high\-concurrency consumer features.
* Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS, enterprise integrations, analytics dashboards and role\-based administration.
* Familiarity with WebSockets, event\-driven architecture, serverless services, content moderation or app\-store releases.



  





 How success will be measured
 


* Features move from concept to production with clear scope, sound engineering and predictable follow\-through.
* The mobile and web experiences feel fast, intuitive and visually refined.
* Video and AI workflows remain reliable despite large files, asynchronous processing and third\-party dependencies.
* The platforms become easier to operate, monitor, secure and scale with every release.
* Technical decisions and risks are documented and communicated before they become blockers.

**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Work model:** 
 Full\-time, work from office
 



**Experience:** 
 Freshers can apply
 



  




 About Progent
 
 Progent is building a world model for the enterprise: an intelligence layer that understands how a business works, makes decisions with context and takes action across its SaaS tools.
 



 We want software to adapt to businesses, instead of businesses adapting to software.
 



  




 The role
 
 As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will turn real business problems into working AI products.
 



 You will speak with users, understand their workflows, build solutions using AI, APIs, databases and MCP, and take them from idea to deployment.
 



  




 You’ll be responsible for
 * Building AI agents, workflows and integrations.
* Taking products from an ambiguous brief to a working deployment.
* Working directly with customers and learning from real usage.
* Debugging problems across code, data and third\-party tools.
* Making practical decisions without getting blocked by non\-critical details.
* Turning customer solutions into reusable Progent capabilities.


- 

 You might be a good fit if
 * You are curious and learn quickly.
* You understand coding basics such as databases, queries, APIs and MCP.
* You have built an AI project at work, in college or for yourself.
* You enjoy owning products end to end.
* You take initiative when something is unclear or broken.
* You communicate well with both technical and non\-technical people.



 We do not require previous work experience or a specific degree. We care more about what you have built, how you think and how quickly you learn.
 



  




 Why Progent
 
 You will join while the product and team are still being shaped. You will solve real problems, ship quickly and have a meaningful voice in what we build.
 



 We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Progent and help build the future of enterprise software.
 


* **To apply:** 
 Send us a short introduction and links to projects, demos or experiments you have built.

title: AI Implementation Engineer
description:
Avensys is a reputed global IT professional services company headquartered in Singapore. Our service spectrum includes enterprise solution consulting, business intelligence, business process automation and managed services. Given our decade of success, we have evolved to become one of the top trusted providers in Singapore and service a client base across banking and financial services, insurance, information technology, healthcare, retail and supply chain.
 



  





 We are currently looking to hire highly skilled AI Implementation Engineer. This is an exciting opportunity to expand your skill set, achieve job satisfaction and work\-life balance. More details as below.
 



  





 Key responsibilities
 


* Build and ship. Implement GenAI features end to end on Azure \- RAG pipelines, agents, APIs, and UI integrations \- against enterprise systems and data.
* Embed and enable. Work inside the delivery pods: pair with their engineers, remove blockers, and transfer GenAI skills so adoption sticks after you move on.
* Productionize. Add evaluation, observability, guardrails, caching, and CI/CD so prototypes become reliable, cost\-efficient services.
* Integrate securely. Connect to enterprise data with correct access control, secrets management, and compliance with enterprise security standards and handling of sensitive data.
* Iterate on quality. Use evaluation results and user feedback to improve grounding, accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Measure. Track delivery and quality metrics that roll up to the program's targets.



  





 Must\-have qualifications
 


* 6\+ years in software engineering, with 2\+ years building GenAI/LLM applications in production.
* Strong Python (incl. async) and Java (the primary enterprise application stack; Spring a plus); solid API and systems design.
* Azure GenAI hands\-on: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search for RAG, Azure AI Document Intelligence (IDP), and Prompt Flow.
* Agent frameworks: Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel / AutoGen (or LangChain / LangGraph) and tool / function calling.
* RAG fundamentals: embeddings, chunking, vector search, reranking, and grounding.
* Data platforms: Snowflake including Cortex AI (Cortex Search, LLM functions) and SQL, for accessing and
* grounding on enterprise data.
* Prompt engineering as versioned code; building and running evaluations.
* DevOps: Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, Docker, AKS / Azure Functions, and observability.



  





 Preferred
 


* Financial services or other regulated environments.
* Front\-end (React) for AI\-assisted UX; streaming and tokenlevel operations.
* Azure AI Content Safety and responsible\-AI practices.
* Certification: Azure AI Engineer Associate



  





**WHAT’S ON OFFER:** 




 You will be remunerated with an excellent base salary and entitled to attractive company benefits. Additionally, you will get the opportunity to enjoy a fun and collaborative work environment, alongside a strong career progression.
 



  





 To submit your application, please apply online or email your UPDATED CV in Microsoft Word format to
 
 Bhawana@aven\-sys.com
 
 Your interest will be treated with strict confidentiality.

 :

 Avensys Consulting Pte Ltd

 :***

title: Digital Twin Lead
description:
**Role Purpose** 




 To establish and lead the foundational Omniverse competency within TCE, driving strategy, architecture, and delivery of digital twin solutions leveraging NVIDIA Omniverse, AI, and simulation technologies. **1\. Omniverse Platform Ownership** 



* Lead the setup, configuration, and scaling of NVIDIA Omniverse Enterprise stack (Nucleus, Kit, Replicator, Isaac Sim, USD pipeline, etc.) within TCE’s environment.
* Evaluate and integrate relevant Omniverse connectors with CAD, PLM, BIM, and AI/ML systems.
* Define architecture for digital twin environments, simulation workflows, and real\-time collaboration using USD (Universal Scene Description).



**2\. Solution Design \& Customer Engagement** 



* Engage with enterprise clients (manufacturing, energy, infrastructure, utilities, smart cities, etc.) to identify use cases and design Omniverse\-based digital twin solutions.
* Translate business and operational needs into Omniverse\-based system architectures and prototypes.
* Create proof\-of\-concepts (POCs), demos, and reference architectures to showcase value.

**3\. Platform Development \& Integration** 



* Work with AI/ML, IoT, and visualization teams to integrate data streams and simulation models into Omniverse environments.
* Lead integration of Omniverse with Unity/Unreal, Python APIs, and AI\-driven analytics tools.
* Build and document reusable modules, SDKs, and data connectors for future scale.



**4\. Evangelism \& Capability Building** 



* Act as TCE’s internal Omniverse evangelist—train cross\-functional teams, define best practices, and represent TCE in NVIDIA ecosystem events.
* Partner with NVIDIA Developer Relations / ISV team to align on joint go\-to\-market initiatives.



  





**Key Skills \& Experience**

 , including Nucleus, Kit, Replicator, or Isaac Sim.

 workflows, 3D data pipelines, and digital twin architectures.
* Experience integrating Omniverse with

 (e.g., Revit, Siemens NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, or Bentley).
* Strong Python or C\+\+ programming skills.
* Exposure to
 **AI/ML** 
 ,
 **simulation** 
 ,
 **rendering pipelines** 
 , or
 **real\-time visualization** 
 technologies.
* Familiarity with
 **NVIDIA RTX, CUDA, DeepStream** 
 , or related GPU computing platforms.
* Experience with
 **cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)** 
 for hosting or scaling digital twin environments.



  





**Professional Competencies** 



* Excellent solutioning and customer\-facing skills – able to translate technical capability into business value.
* Strong system architecture mindset – can design and orchestrate multi\-system integrations.

title: Full Stack Engineering Lead (Python, Angular/React), US Wealth Advisory, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
**Business Unit Overview:**
 US Wealth Advisory (USWA) Business delivers BlackRock's full set of capabilities \- iShares, alpha\-seeking and alternative products, portfolio solutions and technology services \- to wealth management firms and financial advisors in the US.
   

  

 The Advisor Engagement group within the USWA Business delivers a broad set of services and client engagement approaches that amplify the work of our client teams. This includes digital client engagement, business consulting, thought leadership, advisor growth programs, and advisor education. The team also works closely with Global Marketing to design an integrated USWA marketing strategy. WEA (Wealth Enablement and Analytics) Engineering team within Advisor Engagement group is responsible for developing new tools and capabilities which enable Sales, Portfolio Consulting, and other Wealth Distribution partners to self\-service their advisor engagements, and drive innovation and scale.
   

  

**Job Purpose/Background**
 We are seeking an energetic professional to lead a team of Full Stack developers and have hands on technical experience in design and development of Python based Applications and Angular based Interactive Data Visualization solutions.
   

  

 The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing the organization's Applied AI strategy by integrating AI\-powered capabilities into portfolio design platforms, engineering workflows, and business processes. The individual will identify opportunities where AI can create measurable business value, improve productivity, and enhance client and advisor experiences while ensuring responsibility and governed adoption of AI technologies.
   

  

 The individual must have a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and extensive experience building multi\-tier applications. The ideal candidate will thrive in a work environment that requires strong problem\-solving skills and independent self\-direction, coupled with an aptitude for team collaboration and open communication. Attention to detail and creativity in problem solving are critical skills.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team of Full Stack engineers, providing both technical leadership and people management while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives and complex programs, ensuring high\-quality execution, operational excellence, and timely delivery in partnership with business stakeholders and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Define and execute the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for portfolio design platforms and applications, leveraging enterprise capabilities and promoting scalable, reusable solutions that maximize business value.
* Champion Agile software development practices including planning, prioritization, backlog management, sprint execution, and continuous improvement to enhance team effectiveness and delivery outcomes.
* Establish and maintain engineering best practices across software development, production readiness, operational resilience, risk management, and platform governance.
* Lead the adoption of Applied AI technologies and AI\-assisted engineering practices to improve developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and enhance business and client experiences.
* Identify, evaluate, and deliver AI\-enabled solutions, intelligent workflows, and automation opportunities that drive advisor engagement, operational efficiency, and measurable business impact.
* Partner closely with enterprise technology teams and business stakeholders to evaluate emerging technologies and translate innovative capabilities into scalable, production\-ready solutions.
* Promote responsible AI adoption by establishing best practices around governance, security, model evaluation, risk management, and compliance with enterprise standards.
* Serve as a strategic thought partner to business and technology leaders by challenging the status quo, identifying opportunities for innovation, and driving transformational initiatives that advance organizational objectives.
* Mentor and coach engineers and technical leaders, promoting AI literacy, technical excellence, and professional development across the organization.
* Adapt priorities and execution plans to meet evolving business needs while supporting firm\-wide initiatives and delivering high\-impact outcomes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelors or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* 9–12 years of software engineering experience, preferably within the financial services industry, with at least 4 years leading high\-performing Full Stack development teams.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Python and modern web application development using frameworks such as Angular or React, with a solid understanding of APIs, HTTP, and REST\-based architecture.
* Proven experience designing, building, and supporting enterprise\-scale applications, including production infrastructure, deployment architectures, resiliency strategies, and business continuity planning.
* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted development tools and delivering AI\-enabled applications, intelligent workflows, or automation solutions that improve business outcomes and engineering productivity.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and enterprise AI architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or Agentic AI solutions, including exposure to vector databases, semantic search, AI orchestration frameworks, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI principles, governance frameworks, model risk management, and the practical application of AI to software engineering, analytics, advisor engagement, and workflow automation.
* Demonstrated ability to make sound technical and business decisions by balancing risk, governance, operational considerations, and long\-term strategic objectives.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across business and technology organizations globally.
* Track record of delivering high\-impact solutions, building strong partnerships, and achieving high levels of business stakeholder satisfaction.
* Passion for technology and business innovation, with the ability to connect strategic objectives to technical execution and identify opportunities to drive scale and efficiency.
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and wealth management domain is strongly preferred.
* Flexibility to collaborate across global teams and support varying business and delivery schedules as needed.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: AI Full-Stack Developer
description:
What Sphere does
 
 We build automation for companies that still run on spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads, and an ERP nobody enjoys using. Workflow automation, AI agent systems, and ERP integrations for small and mid\-sized businesses across manufacturing, retail, D2C and services.
 



 We're a small team. That's the point: you'll hear about a client's problem on Monday and see something you built running inside their business by Friday.
 


 What you'd actually do
 
 You'll start inside Sphere rather than in front of clients. Internal tooling, lead generation pipelines, and the automations that run our own business, all built under guidance.
 



 Week one, realistically: an n8n pipeline that pulls prospect data from a few sources, enriches it, scores it, and drops a clean shortlist somewhere the team already works. Then you find out it breaks on half the inputs, and you fix that too.
 



 Client\-facing work during the internship is mostly maintenance. Keeping deployed systems running, and learning how they actually work end to end.
 



 At full\-time, the scope opens up. You'll write full backends and own client work directly.
 


 What we're looking for
 * You code with AI assistance and can tell when the output is wrong
* You're fast. A working first draft beats a perfect one that lands next week
* You're curious about industries that aren't tech, and how businesses actually run
* You want to be client\-facing eventually, even if you're not ready for it today


 Nice to have
 * Hands\-on with n8n, Make, or Zapier
* Things you've actually built and shipped. Side projects, freelance work, anything with real users
* Any exposure to ERPs, accounting systems, or business operations


 Who this isn't for
 * Someone who wants a well\-defined ticket queue and clear specs
* Someone who wants to train models and publish papers. This is applied engineering
* Someone who'd rather not talk to clients, ever


 How we hire
 1. Apply. The form takes ten minutes.
2. A short open\-ended project. A few hours. Deliberately under\-specified, because we want to see how you scope something, not whether you can follow instructions.
3. Two conversations. 15 to 60 minutes each, online or at our office. You'll walk through what you built and we'll talk about how you think.
4. Offer.


 Terms
 
 Six months, with the full\-time offer reviewed at month three. This is a hire\-track internship, not a temporary role.
 



 Mumbai hybrid is the preference. Fully remote is open for candidates who are clearly exceptional.
 



 Final\-year students and recent graduates are welcome. One to two years of experience is a plus, not a requirement.

**Qualifications**
* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent degree in Computer Science or Engineering

**Skills And Experience**
* Proven experience operating as a Senior Engineer or Team Lead, defining and owning technical direction across initiatives with Agile Practices such as Lean or Scaled Agile.

* Demonstrated ability to act as a work definer at scale: shaping ambiguous problem spaces into well\-structured initiatives, clear architectural runways, and executable delivery plans.
* Strong background designing enterprise scale, distributed systems, balancing functional requirements with non\-functional concerns such as resiliency, scalability, latency, and operability.


**Hand\-on experience with AI enabled SDLC / PDLC practices, including:**
* Using AI to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and architectural decision making
* Applying AI assisted development, testing, code review, and documentation practices
* Embedding AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services responsibly and securely
* Frameworks such as Windsurf \& Cursor and GitHub Copilot
* Ability to partner effectively with Product Management, Engineering, and Business leaders to translate strategic objectives into coherent architectural strategies.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to articulate complex architectural concepts to senior stakeholders and align diverse teams behind a shared technical vision.
* Track record at articulating architectural tradeoffs and design options, including impacts on scalability, resilience, cost, and delivery velocity.
* Strong architectural governance skills: setting standards, guiding design reviews, managing technical debt, and ensuring long term platform sustainability.
* Experience of API design principles \& Event Driven Architecture.
* Rigorous approach to quality through demonstrable TDD \& BDD experience.


**Nice To Have And Opportunities To Learn**
* Expertise in Domain Driven Design (DDD), including domain modelling and aligning architecture to complex business domains.
* Front office Portfolio Management or Wealth Management domain experience, with a strong understanding of investment workflows, decision making processes, and the role of technology in supporting portfolio managers and advisors.
* Domain knowledge of asset classes \& analytics (e.g., equities, fixed income, multi asset, alternatives) and how their characteristics influence risk, performance, liquidity, and system design.
* Experience with portfolio construction concepts, including asset allocation, constraints, benchmarks, rebalancing, and optimization, and how these map to scalable platform and architecture decisions.
* Exposure to event\-driven architectures at scale, including microservices, messaging, and streaming platforms aligned to business domains.
* Experience shaping or contributing to platform strategies that enable multiple product teams to move faster with consistency and autonomy.
* Familiarity with cloud native and hybrid architectures, including patterns for scalability, resilience, and cost aware design in large enterprises – including frameworks like Kubernetes.
* Exposure to modern DevOps and platform engineering practices that support high throughput, high quality delivery at enterprise scale, and demonstrable improvements across DORA metrics.
* Familiarity with micro frontend architectures, including their use in large scale, multi team environments to enable independent domain ownership, parallel delivery, and consistent user experiences across complex platform


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
